observations: Two photos show a large industrial-looking machine with a black metal frame and white insulated panels.
The machine has two external condenser units mounted on top: one labeled 'LG' and the other 'DAIKIN'.
The machine is outdoors, on a concrete or dirt ground, under a simple roof structure in photo 1.
The white panels appear dirty and stained, with some black discoloration, especially on the sides.
The frame is made of metal, possibly steel, with visible welds and supports.
No visible control panel, branding, or model number on the main body of the machine.
The seller claims it is a 250-block capacity ice block machine made with high-quality materials.
No signs of operation, power connection, or water supply are visible in the photos.

claims.claim: This is 250 blocks capacity ice block machine
claims.evidence: No capacity label or model number visible on the machine. The claim cannot be verified from the photos.
No way to verify material quality from photos alone. The machine appears weathered and stained.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the machine operating, including water flow, freezing cycle, and block ejection.

risks.risk: The machine may not produce 250 blocks per cycle as claimed
risks.proof: Photo or video of the machine producing ice blocks, with a count or measurement of output.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lower capacity, e.g. 100-150 blocks

risks.risk: The machine may have structural or electrical faults
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the control panel, wiring, and internal components, or a video of the machine being powered on.
risks.if_unproven: priced with reduced value for potential repair needs

risks.risk: The machine may be a repurposed or non-standard assembly (e.g., using AC units as cooling source)
risks.proof: Photo or video showing the internal refrigeration system, compressor, and ice-making chamber.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a DIY or non-standard unit, lower value

proof_requests: Video or photo of the machine in operation, showing ice block production.
Close-up of the control panel and internal components.
Photo of the machine's model plate or any identification label.
Photo showing the water inlet and drainage system.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an ice block machine, but critical claims about capacity and condition cannot be verified from the photos. The machine appears to be a custom or repurposed unit using AC condensers, and its functionality and output are unproven. Without proof of operation and capacity, it cannot be priced accurately.
